name: Scallion Chicken
directions: Place a large bowl with a smaller bowl upside down in the middle
Slice up Ginger into large pieces and Spring Onion into ~3in pieces
Place chicken, ginger, onion and dates into the bowl
Once done, Pull chicken out and shred. Keep the chicken stock in the bowl
Slice up the ginger into small cubes and spring onions into small bits
Place ginger, spring oinions, chili flakes, soy sauce, sugar, oyster sauce into bowl
Heat up oil until 325°F and pour over mixure
Add saved chicken stock into the bowl, mix, and add salt and sugar to taste
